body_markdown:
CHARLOTTE, N.C.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Ally Financial (NYSE: ALLY) Chief Executive Officer Michael Rhodes will present at the Goldman Sachs US Financials Conference on Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at approximately 10:40 a.m. ET.


A live webcast will be available on the day of the conference at[http://www.ally.com/about/investor/](http://www.ally.com/about/investor/) under the Events and Presentations section of the Investor Relations website. A replay will also be available.


**About Ally Financial**


Ally Financial Inc. (NYSE: ALLY) includes the nation's largest all-digital bank and auto finance business, driven by a mission to "Do It Right" for its customers and communities. Ally is a U.S. financial holding company with $203 billion in assets and 9.7 million customers (as of September 30, 2026). Ally Bank, Member FDIC, offers online banking products, including high-yield savings and no hidden fee checking, and was the first major U.S. bank to eliminate overdraft fees. Ally also provides investing solutions through Ally Invest, including online brokerage, automated investing, IRAs and personal advice. As a leader in auto finance, Ally provides consumer and dealer financing, insurance, and vehicle remarketing services. Ally's seasoned corporate finance business provides capital to equity sponsors and middle-market companies, as well as financing to well-established asset managers that provide leveraged loans to middle-market companies. Visit[ally.com](https://www.ally.com/) .
